<thought>We will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates whose forward reaction breaks a halide (alkyl/aryl halide) and forms a primary amine, matching the SN2 transformation described. This should return a small set of candidate templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
